header:

United States · Mathematics PhD

Eligibility and preparation · Deadlines by stage · English and GRE · Academic records · Recommendation letters · Written
materials · Funding and fees · Conflicts and remaining checks · Faculty · Sources
Pay attention to
• Letters have explicit December 22, 2026 extension beyond December 15 application.

leave/moves must be confirmed; paper dates describe the cited version.

sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Four-year bachelor’s with B average on most recent degree/subsequent work; proof-based linear algebra, real
analysis/advanced calculus, abstract algebra at B average. International bachelor’s applicants accepted. [s1]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Prepare one-page SOP, CV, upper division course descriptions/textbooks/grades; indicate TA/RA interest in
application. [s1] [s2]
Adviser contact [Unresolved]
No public requirement to secure an adviser before submitting was established in the admissions pages
checked. Use the research-fit shortlist for potential contacts and confirm 2027 availability/graduate supervision
eligibility. A faculty listing does not promise an opening. [s1] [s2]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
Check status online; official admission from Graduate Admissions distinct from department recommendation.
Certification of Finances required for visa documents including funded students; current U.S. visa/I-20 copy
requested. [s2] [s4]
Cycle verification [2027 confirmed]
Explicit Fall 2027 application December 15, 2026 and letters December 22, 2026; stipend only 2024-25. [s1] [s3]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Standing rule]
Old TOEFL 80≥18 each; new TOEFL total 4, R/L/W 4, S 3.5; IELTS 6.5; DET 110 with subscores. GTAs: old TOEFL
speaking 22/IELTS 7; new scale GTA threshold not clear. Scores valid 2 years through first registration. No
MyBest. [s4]
UChicago English exemption [Conflict]
Preparing page says proof required if prior degree outside U.S./other English country, supporting UChicago
exemption. Dedicated waiver country list oddly omits U.S.; confirm U.S. degree exception and expected degree
handling directly. [s4] [s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Optional; all submitted scores considered. PDF/copies accepted with name, date, all scores; may request
official verification. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Optional; same PDF/verification policy. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
Published entering GTA 2024-25$2177/month for 9 months ($19, 593 arithmetic), tuition remission and 90%
student health premium. Older than requested cycle; 2027 rate unknown. Summer appointments limited. [s3]
Years of support [Unresolved]
Guaranteed number of years not published on checked funding page; stipend increases with advancement. [s3]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students eligible competitive GTA/RA subject spoken English; individual award may not cover full
visa expense estimate. [s4]
Conditions and duties [Standing rule]
GTA 16 hours/week typically 4-5 contact, 3 office, 3 tutoring, 5-6 preparation; teaching workshop/first-year
seminar. [s3]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Select TA and/or RA consideration in application; no separate assistantship form. Notify committee of
scholarship eligibility. [s2]
Other funding routes [Standing rule]
University/College of Science fellowships; research assistantships depending grant; some summer
teaching/internships/RA. Award-specific deadlines communicated by committee. [s3]
Application fee [Standing rule]
$85 degree-seeking international and domestic; nonrefundable. [s5]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Central policy explicitly no fee waivers for international students. Domestic requests before submit; not
applicable to F-1 solely because UChicago enrollment. [s6]

sections.title: Potential advisers and recent research
sections.text:
Number theory
Clayton Petsche
Arithmetic dynamics, arboreal Galois representations, heights, and non-Archimedean dynamics. [faculty1]
Professor; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Non-abelian arboreal Galois groups associated to PCF rational maps
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Holly Swisher
Modular/mock modular forms, partitions, hypergeometric series, and supercongruences. [faculty2] [faculty2a]
Professor; personal research site linked by official OSU directory; availability unconfirmed.
Research evidence: 2025 · Supercongruences arising from Ramanujan-Sato series
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
Representation theory
Jonathan Kujawa
Lie superalgebras, categorical representation theory, Schur-Weyl duality, and web categories. [faculty4]
[faculty4a]
Department Head, Professor, Hartmann Faculty Scholar; moved from Oklahoma to Oregon State in 2024.
Research evidence: 2026 submitted · Interpolating Schur algebras
Official publication evidence for the stated research match.
